title: Walsh characters take values in the unit sphere
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S \subseteq [n]$, and let $x \in \{0,1\}^n$. Then the Walsh–Fourier character $\chi_S(x) = \prod_{i \in S}(-1)^{x_i}$ satisfies
\[
  \chi_S(x)\,\chi_S(x) = 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: x a point of the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
